schedule: warm-up rounds identical to measured rounds; every measured run preceded by `settle` discarded runs of the same variant in the same worker; ABBA counterbalanced (rounds 0,3 of 4: A first; 1,2: B first) for base/cand and offA/abil; subs rotate

summary.status: quiet machine (competing CPU <= 0.05 and steal <= 0.05 CPU in every scene); official only when the owner accepts the conditions; results labelled PROVISIONAL stay provisional

quietRule.note: quiet = competing CPU (total busy - the benchmark's own processes) at most 0.05 CPU and steal at most 0.05 CPU, averaged over the window (/proc/stat, /proc/<pid>/stat); load averages recorded, not the rule

R1same.note: old same-process figure: ratio of the medians, both in the ability worker (now with the balanced schedule)

R1cross.note: old protocol R1: abilities on (ability worker) / abilities off (matched worker); two processes; reported, not the figure

processState.note: the twin in the ability worker / the twin in the matched worker (same build, same scene): the difference between the two processes
